c1-36-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Passive Resistance
c1-36-01.scenario: At a talk about Deák Ferenc, a friend asks what passive resistance meant.
c1-36-01.prompt: Tell your friend what was done and not done.
cues: Say what was not carried out
Say what was not taken up
c1-36-01.target: A törvénytelen rendeleteket nem hajtották végre.
c1-36-01.english: The unlawful decrees were not carried out.
c1-36-01.canDo: I can say what was not done in passive resistance, without naming who did it (*nem hajtották végre*, *nem fizették be*).

c1-36-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Rights and Freedoms
c1-36-02.scenario: A friend asks what equality before the law means.
cues: Say what it means for everybody
c1-36-02.target: A jogegyenlőség azt jelenti, hogy a törvény mindenkire egyformán vonatkozik.
c1-36-02.english: Equality before the law means that the law applies to everybody in the same way.
c1-36-02.canDo: I can name rights with nouns in *-ság/-ség* (*jogegyenlőség*, *lelkiismereti szabadság*).

c1-36-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Freedom without Fear
c1-36-03.scenario: After reading about Bibó István, a friend says that freedom is dangerous.
c1-36-03.prompt: Answer your friend with a question.
cues: Ask why we should fear freedom
Say who gets a share of it
c1-36-03.target: Miért félnénk a szabadságtól, ha mindenkinek jut belőle?
c1-36-03.english: Why should we fear freedom if everybody gets a share of it?
c1-36-03.canDo: I can ask a rhetorical question about freedom and fear (*miért félnénk a szabadságtól?*).

c1-36-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Two Views of the Compromise
c1-36-04.scenario: A friend asks how Deák's supporters and Kossuth Lajos saw the Compromise of 1867.
c1-36-04.prompt: Tell your friend the two views.
c1-36-04.target: Deák hívei elfogadták a kiegyezést, Kossuth viszont a veszélyeire figyelmeztetett.
c1-36-04.english: Deák's supporters accepted the Compromise, Kossuth, however, warned of its dangers.
c1-36-04.canDo: I can contrast two views with *viszont* and *noha* (*Deák hívei elfogadták, Kossuth viszont …*).

c1-36-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Civic Responsibility
c1-36-05.scenario: A friend asks what citizens owe to a free country.
c1-36-05.target: Nemcsak jogaink vannak, hanem kötelességeink is.
c1-36-05.english: We have not only rights but also duties.
c1-36-05.canDo: I can link two duties with *nemcsak … hanem* and *egyrészt … másrészt*.

c1-36-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: What Remains of the Tradition
c1-36-consolidation.scenario: A friend asks what you learned in this unit about the Hungarian tradition of liberty.
cues: Say what must also be done
c1-36-consolidation.target: Nemcsak a törvényeket kell megalkotni, hanem be is kell tartani őket.
c1-36-consolidation.english: Laws must not only be made but also kept.
c1-36-consolidation.canDo: I can use the words for passive resistance, rights, freedom without fear, the Compromise and civic responsibility.
